description: Platform capabilities a behavior contract transition or vector may require (spec/behavior-contract.md). An implementation on a platform without a capability neither runs nor fails the vectors that need it.

values.label: Pointer hover
values.description: The platform has a pointer that can hover without pressing. Without it (touch), the `hovered` facet never becomes true.

values.label: Keyboard
values.description: The platform has a keyboard, so focus can arrive by keyboard and `focusVisible` can become true.

values.label: Assistive activation
values.description: The platform lets assistive technology activate a control directly (a VoiceOver double tap, a screen reader activate action).
